'''Fire extinguisher canisters''' were part of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] survival kits. [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] used one to hide his [[Nejaa Halcyon|grandfather's]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] during the [[Battle of Ciutric]].
